// "Window Seat After Hours"
// 01 — Lights low | 112 BPM
setcpm(112/4)

$: s("bd ~ ~ ~")
  .bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.58)
$: s("~ rim ~ ~")
  .bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.27)
$: s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909")
  .gain(".17 .08 .13 .08").swingBy(.12,4)
$: s("~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.12)

$: note("<c2!2 ab1!2 eb2!2 bb1!2>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~").s("sawtooth")
  .lpf(380).attack(.01)
  .decay(.16).sustain(.08).release(.08).gain(0.22)

$: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3]!2 [c3,eb3,g3]!2 [g3,bb3,d4]!2 [d3,f3,ab3]!2>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ ~").s("triangle")
  .attack(0.12).decay(.5).sustain(.2).release(.7)
  .lpf(1600).room(.38).orbit(2).gain(0.18)

$: note("~").s("sine")
  .attack(.005).decay(.14).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .lpf(2400).delay(.23).delaytime(.267857)
  .delayfeedback(.28).room(.25).orbit(3).gain(0.14)

// "Neon Detour"
// 138 BPM - acid house
setcpm(138/4)

$: s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.62)
$: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.38)
$: s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808")
  .gain(".13 .05 .09 .05").swingBy(.1,8)
$: s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.14).cut(1)

$: note("d2 [~ d3] f2 [c2 d2]")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(350,1800).slow(8))
  .lpq(3).lpenv(3).lpd(.12)
  .attack(.003).decay(.14).sustain(0).release(.06)
  .gain(.23)

$: n("0 2 4 6 4 2 1 3").scale("D4:minor")
  .s("square").lpf(2200)
  .attack(.003).decay(.08).sustain(0).release(.05)
  .delay(.2).delaytime(.217391).delayfeedback(.25)
  .pan(".3 .7").orbit(3).gain(.09)

$: note("<[d3,f3,a3] [bb2,d3,f3] [f3,a3,c4] [c3,e3,g3]>")
  .struct("~ x ~ x").s("sawtooth").lpf(1100)
  .attack(.01).decay(.16).sustain(0).release(.15)
  .room(.22).orbit(2).gain(.12)
